meta.title: dsh-lang-rule
meta.description: Deployment-level language policy v2: head anchor -900, subagent anchor -880, post-tools reminder 5100, tail first-sentence anchor 90050, and per-request runtime-context 500, requiring Simplified Chinese from the first sentence for the main agent, subagents, AgentTeams members and background jobs; degrades to four sections when the host or another plugin suppresses runtime context.
